improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon is, its AI foundation, and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price and free searches creates transparency and qualifies clicks, reducing bounce rates.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces Gideon by name, establishing brand recognition while clearly communicating the product category (AI assistant for trade and business). The subheading reinforces three key value props—instant answers, voice chat, and professional support—while the free trial CTA reduces friction and encourages immediate engagement. The copy is concise, avoids unverified claims, and speaks directly to the target audience of business owners and traders.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users approaching the paywall. It transparently explains the transition from free to paid, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the annual savings—reducing uncertainty and encouraging conversion without pressure.
